paper: CycleNet: Enhancing Time Series Forecasting through Modeling Periodic Patterns (arXiv 2409.18479)
notes: From-scratch re-implementation of the official CycleNet (RCF, W=24, RevIN, channel-independent backbone). Official ETTh1 hyper-params: Adam, batch 256, lr 0.01 (Linear) / 0.005 (MLP, d_model 512), 30 epochs, patience 5, lradj type3. Single seed 2024 (paper averages 5 seeds). features=M, all 7 channels, stride-1 test (2785 windows).
